title: Bear Valley Community Hospital
description: About Bear Valley Community Hospital Bear Valley Community Healthcare District offers a wide range of emergency medical and healthcare services in Big Bear Valley, including urgent care, family health, and specialized medical treatments. Their services encompass various fields such as cardiology, behavioral health, rehabilitation, and dental care, catering to patients of all ages. The organization aims to provide high-quality healthcare regardless of insurance status, ensuring accessibility for the community. A Bear Valley Community Hospital suffered a cyberattack leading to the theft of over 400 GB of sensitive data. As a result of the data breach, employee data, the company’s confidential financial information, bank documents, patients’ personal documents, Social Security numbers, medical records, medical histories, and surgical records were stolen.
